record.question: Which city is called 'Gibraltar of Indian Ocean'?
record.explanation: Answer B: Aden. A 1929 House of Commons debate explicitly refers to Aden as the ‘Gibraltar of the Indian Ocean’. Reference: https://hansard.parliament.uk/commons/1929-07-11/debates/a3e435ff-95dd-4cb3-8321-79eb85220b9c/GovernmentOfIndia%28Aden%29Bill. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
